title: Band spirit and Ellington drawing apart
summary: The early band was like brothers; Ellington was close to them at first but moved apart as the management built the star image.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Was there a great deal of musical cooperation among the members of the band when you first joined it, or was there rivalry or competitiveness?
No, they were just like a bunch of brothers. Everybody looked out for each other and helped each
A good -- a good spirit then?
Did that include Duke too, or did Duke hold himself apart as he did later?

Well, at first he was very much together with the boys. He had learned to what they were doing. But later on when he got confidence in himself -- and he didn't need them anymore. So, he went by himself. Also the management encouraged him to go with them and by himself because in that way he would leave the idea in the public's mind that he was the almighty.
